nodes.label: Development calibration experiment v1
nodes.rationale: Pre-register exactly 27 stop/reward/holding configurations over nine retrospectively selected development sessions. Preserve the original engine and baseline; freeze all other fixtures and retain no-trade/invalid candidates with source, data, configuration and result hashes.

nodes.label: Continuous-account chronological calibration
nodes.rationale: One pinned engine carries cash, positions, timers, reservations and share basis across dates. Returns require flat opening/closing boundaries for every requested date. Chronological folds slice that account; independently reset accounts cannot be presented as one policy path.

nodes.label: Development-only selection block
nodes.rationale: Diagnostic ranking is exploratory and may favor no-trade policies. candidate_for_holdout and selected_config must remain null because the sample, universe, uncertainty, acceptance limits and untouched holdout are inadequate. Cost and timing stresses are separate fixtures, not optimization dimensions.
